scripts.render:teaser: remotion render Teaser out/teaser-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/teaser-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/gluco-teaser.mp4
scripts.render:walkthrough: remotion render Walkthrough out/walkthrough-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/walkthrough-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/gluco-walkthrough.mp4
